definitions.explanation: Careful thought and investigation of a matter.

examples.japanese: {検討|けんとう}してからお{返事|へんじ}します。
examples.english: I will reply after considering it.

examples.japanese: {計画|けいかく}を{検討|けんとう}する。
{検討|けんとう}の{結果|けっか}、{中止|ちゅうし}となった。
examples.english: As a result of consideration, it was canceled.

notes:
{検討|けんとう} means careful examination.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {検討|けんとう}する (to examine)
- {検討|けんとう}を{重|かさ}ねる (to consider carefully)
- {検討|けんとう}{中|ちゅう} (under consideration)
- {検討|けんとう}{課題|かだい} (issue to be considered)

NOTE: Often used in business contexts as a polite way to delay giving an answer.
